title: Pin the actual implementation
deliver: Commit, working-tree state, relevant environment/dependency versions, app entrypoints and limits on what was inspected. Keep credentials and customer material out of the handoff.

title: Trace the real app path
deliver: One trace from UI request or intake through API, worker, interpretation, record admission, calculations and rendered output. Document diagnostic-only paths and actual divergence.

title: Register known defects
deliver: Enumerate distinct failure classes from evidence: instruction time handling, number normalization, parent/child admission, stale/repeated approval, missing comparisons, outlet/item/unit links and gross/net/payable/payment semantics. For each record reproduced, not reproduced, fixed with evidence, or blocked—not an assumed count.

title: Map reusable components
deliver: Locate existing exact calculations, permission checks, relationship/state records, invalidation, reports and task mechanisms. Mark present-tested-at-commit, present-untested, partial, absent or not-audited.

title: Check the 1.4 semantics
deliver: Map CL01–CL05 and AT01–AT10 to existing code or a specific gap. Propose minimal extensions to existing records; do not introduce a general accounting/workflow engine.

title: Prepare the bounded development case
deliver: Normal receipt → shortage → ambiguous follow-up → correction → report revision → manager acknowledgement → evidence-backed resolution with separate physical/billing/loss outcomes. This is the development scenario; reserve unseen variants separately.

title: Establish data and evaluation boundaries
deliver: Use synthetic fixtures until applicable grants, source filtering and isolation checks pass. Prepare the two scorecards, format/write checks and fair baseline arms. Schedule the low-fidelity acknowledgement trial with the future named manager.

title: Return a concrete S1 proposal
deliver: Produce code paths, reproduction commands/results, reusable components, blocking gaps, residual uncertainties, smallest S1 repair tasks and estimates with assumptions. Identify the shared critical-output interface and any local audit fixture/instrumentation changes.
